name: BBW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The only belt Buck Brothers Wrestling could afford: an unaltered WWE replica title, John Cena side plates still on it, hung on a promotion run out of a flea market to bring vendors through the door. The founding pitch says the quiet part itself — calling it a world title is a joke, but the promotion is a joke, so it all works out. No champion was ever named, no match for it ever announced, and no card it might have been defended on was ever run.
notes: Declared in the founding pitch's own CHAMPIONSHIP section, which also describes the physical belt: a WWE replica, bought as-is with no alterations and John Cena side plates. The pitch names no other championship — "[t]hat's all they can afford for now" — and the promotion never launched, so no reign, tournament or contender for it exists.
